t: What Decentralized AI Inference Protocols Is
title: What Decentralized AI Inference Protocols Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Decentralized AI inference protocols let anyone run AI models across networks of independent machines: a request is routed to nodes with the model and spare capacity, computed with cryptographic verification, and paid for automatically — inference without a central provider. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Decentralized AI Inference Protocols: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Decentralized AI Inference Protocols in one line: Decentralized AI inference protocols let anyone run AI models across networks of independent machines: a request is routed to nodes with the model and spare capacity, computed with cryptographic verification, and paid for automatically — inference without a central provider.
Why it matters: They break the cloud monopoly on AI: open models served by open networks, resistant to censorship and single points of failure..
Where it is used: open-model serving, censorship-resistant AI, community compute, private inference..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
